messages:
maria: quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4212 ready for review. Changes: tracehook rename + metrics split for kv-cache, and a small dashboard tweak. Need 2 approvals for canary deploy today. can someone take a look? :pray:
ajay: looking now, can you call out the metric name changes? want to make sure telemetry dashboards don't break the alerts
maria: sure — renamed `console.trace.duration_ms` -> `console.trace.latency_ms` and split `kv.cache.hit_rate` -> `kv.cache.client_hit_rate` + `kv.cache.server_hit_rate`. Also updated the dashboard panels that query the old names, left a migration note in the PR description.
sophie: I can review the tracehook change in ~20m. heads-up CI flaky on one test (flaky: tests/telemetry/test_aggregation.py::test_padding) — rerun might be needed. :eyes:
ci-bot: CircleCI build #7890 completed — 1 failed, 3 passed. Re-run requested by sophie.
dave: thanks — is the canary window still today? need to coordinate with oncall for tracing spike watch
maria: planning a 2-hour canary starting 16:30 PT (roughly 2 hours from now). oncall should be able to monitor traces + APM. Will add the canary tag in rollout config if approvals land.
lisa: giving a quick +1 on dashboard JSON, left one nit about a legend label.
sophie: left inline comments on the tracehook file, small suggestion re: null handling. will re-approve after CI green and the tiny fix.
ajay: approved — looks good to me, didn't see any perf regressions in the microbench outputs included in the PR.
maria: awesome, thanks all. sophie — when CI is green and you re-approve i'll kick off the canary. tagging @oncall in the canary plan thread. :rocket:
